name: SUP Game Box Portable Console | 400 Classic Games in 1 Entertainment Device
description:
The SUP Game Box is a handheld retro gaming console packed with 400 built-in classic games. Featuring a 3.0-inch TFT color screen, it delivers smooth gameplay and portable fun for kids and adults alike. With its rechargeable 600mAh battery, you can enjoy up to 3–4 hours of playtime on the go. It also supports TV connectivity and multiplayer gaming with the included joystick, making it a perfect entertainment device for home or travel.

Key Features
400 built-in retro arcade and adventure games
3.0-inch TFT color screen for clear display
Rechargeable 600mAh battery with 3–4 hours playtime
TV connectivity via included AV cable
Extra joystick included for multiplayer gaming
Portable, lightweight design for kids and adults

Ingredients / Materials
Plastic Shell, TFT Display, Electronic Components, Lithium Battery

How to Use
Charge the console fully before use
Power on and select from 400 built-in games
Connect to TV via AV cable for big-screen play
Use the joystick for multiplayer gaming

Package Includes
1 × SUP Game Console (Random Color)
1 × Built-in 400 Games
1 × AV Cable
1 × Charging Cable
1 × User Manual
